versions.content: If the TLS_SERVER receives the ClientKeyExchange message during the handshake and TcpIpTlsPresharedKeyIdentity or TcpIpTlsPresharedKeyCsmKeyRef is not defined but TcpIpTlsPskGetServerKeyIdentityFunc is defined, then this function shall be called when the TLS_CLIENT assembles the ClientKeyExchange message (according to RFC4279, Sect. 2). The function provides the pre-shared key and the psk_identity which is provided in the ClientKeyExchange message.
